record.question: Which Indian personality was recently bestowed with France's highest civilian honour 'Knight of the Legion of Honour'?
record.explanation: Answer D: Jawahar Lal Sarin. Contemporary reports identify Jawahar Lal Sarin as receiving France’s Knight of the Legion of Honour in 2018. The wording ‘highest civilian honour’ is an imprecise description of this grade, but the listed recipient is Sarin. Reference: https://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/jawahar-lal-sarin-honoured-with-france-s-highest-civilian-honour-118110901244_1.html; https://www.legiondhonneur.fr/fr/les-decorations/les-decorations-francaises/la-legion-dhonneur. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
